maria.g: Heads-up: finalizing the calibration + prompt pool for the FP8/INT8/GPTQ/AWQ bakeoff. need agreement on sampling strategy and slices. @akash @oliver @tanya

akash: high level: keep it small but representative. my proposal: 55% prod-match by route, 20% adversarial/hard, 15% edge/rare, 10% gold sanity checks. ensure >=500 examples per slice where possible.

oliver: add an explicit per-model length stratification. quant noise often shows above 512 tokens. length buckets: 0-64, 65-256, 257-512, 513-2048+.

tanya: +1. also include locale and tokenization stress (unicode, mixed scripts). i can curate ~800 adversarial/edge candidates with labels.

maria.g: for prompts: we should store base templates and mutation scripts (typos, punctuation, code formatting, instruction variants). seed everything for reproducibility.

akash: evaluation modes: canonical = deterministic (greedy) for token/seq deltas; secondary = sampling with fixed seeds (top-k/top-p) for robustness checks. run 3 samples per prompt in sampling mode.

oliver: metrics to capture: overall token delta, seq EM/F1/ROUGE where applicable, logit cosine, calibration plots, and a ranked list of top divergent prompts with diffs.

tanya: add an 'upweight_hard' reporting toggle so stakeholders see weighted deltas focused on hard slices. also track per-slice median latency and peak memory.

maria.g: good. suggest we also include a 30-probe quick-check set to catch catastrophic regressions fast.

akash: operational note: i'll pin the runs to a fixed GPU image and log driver/kernel/kernelspecs. will spin up test infra tomorrow AM.

oliver: i'll prepare the visualization notebook: side-by-side diffs, per-slice waterfall, and token-level heatmaps. will include scripts to extract top-20 divergent outputs.

maria.g: propose eval-config for the harness (will commit to repo):
```
{
  "slices": ["prod_match","adversarial","edge","sanity"],
  "slice_weights": {"prod_match":55,"adversarial":20,"edge":15,"sanity":10},
  "length_buckets": [64,256,512,2048],
  "decode_modes": ["greedy","top_k_sampling"],
  "samples_per_prompt_sampling": 3,
  "seeded_mutations": true,
  "upweight_hard_report": true
}
```

tanya: i'll upload the adversarial candidates + labels here: https://redwood.example/drive/quant-edge-archive

akash: action items: 1) maria to push sampling + mutation scripts (seeded) by EOD today; 2) akash to provision runs for FP8/INT8/GPTQ/AWQ by tomorrow AM; 3) oliver to implement metric extraction & viz; 4) tanya to finalize adversarial labels.

maria.g: i'll also include a trace file that records sampling seeds and provenance for each prompt. will post the pool JSON in this thread when ready.

eval-bot: started rungroup 2026-03-21-quant-bakeoff-fast-checks. status: queued. :robot_face:

maria.g: last call: any objections to slice weights or length buckets? shout now, otherwise locking and kicking off infra requests.
